purpose: Separate fixed insurance-sector trading diagnostic for hurricane-risk satellite forecasts; no orders
assets: KIE insurance ETF versus SPY market ETF; broad insurance-sector proxy includes businesses not directly exposed to Atlantic losses
evaluation: 2006–2025 inclusive, complete common price windows and available frozen forecasts only; no tuning
signal: For satellite and nonsatellite baseline separately, short KIE/longSPY when predicted AugNov ACE > expanding prior-year mean ACE; longKIE/shortSPY when below; flat if equal. Incremental overlay instead compares satellite to baseline. Two legs each50%notional on capital, 100%gross exposure.
entry: First common trading close on or after August1, after forecast issued00UTC; exit last common trading close on or before November30. Same windows allstrategies.
costs: 10bps perleg pertrade times0.5notional =20bps fullroundtrip; borrow3percent annual on0.5shortleg overactualdaycount. Doubledexecutioncost sensitivity. No leverage financing beyondshortborrow.
prices: Yahoo Finance adjusted closes account fordistributions/splits inlongreturn; shortreturn usesnegativeadjustedtotalreturn (includesdistributionsowed). Currentadjustedvintage.
uncertainty: Whole-season bootstrap10000seed20260927, mean netreturns and paired differences;20events maximum. Report eventcompounding only, not annualized or risk-adjustedalpha.
gate: Tradingalpha isnotcertified bythis exploratory test. Reportpositive neteconomicresults only ifmean netreturns andpairedadvantageoverbaseline bothhavepositive95percent intervals; otherwiseunverified.
limits: NOAA/publicforecasts alreadyusesimilar climateinformation; no claim tobeatconsensus
